name: Bichlalm
kurzbeschreibung: The idyllic Bichlalm pasture at 1,600 metres above Kitzbühel captivates visitors with sunny alpine meadows, the scenic chairlift, and sweeping vistas of the Wilder Kaiser.
preis: Alpine pasture and hiking trails freely accessible; Bichlalmbahn chairlift fares apply
oeffnungszeiten: Chairlift operates daily during summer season from late May to mid-October
beschreibung:
Überblick

The idyllic Bichlalm sits at an elevation of approximately 1,600 metres on the sun-drenched southern ridges of the Bichlalm massif above Kitzbühel. Removed from the bustling race crowds of the legendary Streif and Hahnenkamm, the Bichlalm serves as an insider tip for tranquil hikers, nature lovers, and devotees of classic Tyrolean mountain hospitality. Rolling grassy peaks, vibrant wildflower pastures, and sparse larch groves characterize this high-alpine plateau. From the sweeping sun deck of the Bichlalm mountain inn and the surrounding footpaths, visitors revel in a captivating 360-degree panorama: to the north, the sheer limestone ramparts of the Wilder Kaiser command the skyline, while to the south, the glaciated summits of the Hohe Tauern and Großvenediger glisten in the sunlight. The plateau harmoniously blends living dairy heritage with alpine relaxation.

Route & Anforderungen

The Bichlalm can be reached smoothly aboard the single-seater Bichlalmbahn chairlift or via scenic hiking paths on foot. From the valley lift station in the Bichln district of Kitzbühel, a well-marked mountain trail ascends past the Obergaisbergalm in about two hours of moderate hiking (approx. 650 vertical metres). Once atop the ridge, gentle panoramic walks await, including the rewarding crest walk toward the Hochetzkogel or onward to the Stuckkogel peak. For strolling along the plateau and resting at the inn, comfortable lightweight walking shoes suffice; for the foot ascent from the valley or longer ridge hikes, supportive ankle-high hiking boots with vibram tread, rain gear, and sun protection are strongly recommended.

Besuch & Anreise

Arrival by road proceeds via motorway A12 (exit Wörgl Ost) along federal routes B178 and B170 to Kitzbühel. From the town center, follow directional signs toward the Bichln borough and the Bichlalmbahn bottom station, where complimentary guest parking is provided. By train, travelers alight at Kitzbühel Hauptbahnhof or Kitzbühel Hahnenkamm station and take local municipal or VVT regional bus routes toward Bichln directly to the lift base.

Tipps

Relax upon the panoramic sun terrace and sample authentic Tyrolean alpine delicacies, including fresh pan-fried Kaiserschmarrn and savory cheese spaetzle. Early morning hikers are rewarded by spectacular sunrise light bathing the rugged limestone cliffs of the Wilder Kaiser in radiant gold.
